tax.text: Lopez voted against placing a measure on the ballot that would indefinitely extend Santa Ana's temporary sales tax increase.
tax.quote: I just strongly feel like I can’t break that deal with our constituents

housing.text: Lopez said she wants California to expand affordable housing and has supported and funded housing development in Santa Ana.
housing.quote: At the state level, I want to build on that work by expanding affordable housing

schools.text: Lopez's Assembly campaign makes fully funding public education a stated priority.
schools.quote: Great schools, supportive teachers, and opportunity for every student.

safety.text: Lopez answered yes to shifting some public safety responses for homelessness and mental health incidents to trained social service providers.
safety.quote:
Will you support policies that shift public safety responses to trained social service providers for homelessness and mental health incidents? 
 Jessie Lopez ( d ) 
 Yes

sentencing.text: In her IJ Action questionnaire, Lopez backed reforming sentencing enhancements, increasing judicial discretion and ending mandatory minimums.
sentencing.quote: reforming sentencing enhancements, increasing judicial discretion, and eliminating mandatory minimums

immigration.text: Lopez pledged to defend immigrant families and communities against federal immigration enforcement actions.
immigration.quote: Protect our families and immigrant communities from Trump’s brutal ICE force.

guns.text: Lopez's campaign says Moms Demand Action recognized her for supporting gun-safety policies and gun-violence prevention.
guns.quote: standing up for commonsense gun safety and working to prevent gun violence

abortion.text: Lopez says she has received a 100% Planned Parenthood rating for supporting reproductive health care and abortion-related bodily autonomy.
abortion.quote: Jessie Lopez earned a 100% rating from the Planned Parenthood Community Action Fund for standing up for reproductive health care, bodily autonomy, and every person’s right to make their own healthcare decisions.

health.text: Lopez explicitly said she supports Medicare for All.
health.quote: which is why I support Medicare for All.

energy.text: Lopez requested a Santa Ana climate resolution that committed the city to fully clean and renewable energy by 2045 and policies limiting fossil-fuel expansion.
energy.quote: committing to 100% clean and renewable energy usage by 2045.

tax.text: Penaloza pledges to prevent tax increases and keep California tax dollars in the state.
tax.quote: Prevent tax increases and ensure our tax dollars stay in California.

housing.text: Penaloza says he helped build 2,000 housing units and supports cutting red tape and incentivizing affordable construction.
housing.quote: On the City Council, David helped build 2,000 new housing units. David will work to cut red tape, incentivize affordable housing construction, and help working families buy starter homes.

schools.text: Penaloza calls for fully funding public education and providing educators with more resources.
schools.quote: David believes in fully funding our public education system. He’s committed to lowering costs for attending college, giving our students the tools to succeed, and providing educators with the resources they need.

safety.text: Penaloza says he helped hire 50 additional police officers and wants police and fire departments to receive more resources and tools.
safety.quote: As a Councilmember, he helped hire 50 more police officers and created new ordinances to ban street takeovers and street racing. He’ll help secure the resources and tools our police and fire departments need.

immigration.text: Penaloza's office taught residents their rights during immigration sweeps, and he accused federal agents of ignoring those rights and engaging in racial profiling.
immigration.quote: People know about their rights. But what do we do when those rights are being ignored?

energy.text: Penaloza supports investing in clean-energy infrastructure to combat climate change.
energy.quote: He’s committed to curbing air and water pollution for every resident, and investing in the clean energy infrastructure California needs to combat climate change.
